title: Add task-store parse fault isolation and malformed-record recovery
description:
Problem: tasks loading currently deserializes all task JSON files with fail-fast behavior; one malformed record can crash task surfaces with HTTP 500.

Desired outcome: preserve task API/page availability by isolating malformed files and surfacing actionable diagnostics for recovery.

Scope:
- In scope: per-file parse try/catch in task loading, structured logging with filename, malformed file quarantine or skip strategy, admin-visible diagnostics, and regression tests.
- Out of scope: redesign of task schema.

Acceptance criteria:
- `/tasks` and `/api/tasks` remain available when at least one malformed task file exists.
- Malformed records are clearly reported with stable error metadata and file identity.
- Recovery flow is documented and test-covered.

Validation:
- Introduce a malformed fixture file in isolated test data and verify no 500 on list routes.
- Verify logs and diagnostics include expected identifiers without leaking sensitive data.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Follow-up convergence task created from runtime evidence of intermittent /tasks 500 due to JSON parse failure in task loading.
